rule: Convert one launch activation sprint into production-safe records with one owner, one proof state, one direct route, one listing SaaS signal, one go/no-go decision, and blocked rental payment custody.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, or commission record is created in phase one; Heavyster earns listing SaaS only.

record_sets.success_signal: Supplier reply is tracked without platform payment custody
Paid listing ARR is visible before publish
Scale only after supply, trust, direct route, and ARR are ready

acceptance: Shows one production record room after the Launch Activation Sprint.
Buyer records include direct enquiry, proof snapshot, supplier direct route, and reply follow-up.
Supplier records include account, listing, proof document, listing subscription, and direct lead route.
Founder records include launch room, supplier target, proof gate, listing ARR, and go/no-go decision.
Every record set declares an allowed route and a blocked payment route.
Static check protects version, UI, docs, copy action, route guardrails, and contract.
